title: Positive exactness of small free abelian Cech presheaf chains
statement: Let $C$ be a category with objects in universe $u$ and Hom sets in $v$, with finite wide pullbacks. Let $X\in C$, let $I$ be a type in $v$, and let $\pi_i:U_i\to X$ be any family. In degree $n$, define the presheaf $T_n(Z)=\coprod_{t:\mathrm{Fin}(n+1)\to I}\operatorname{Hom}_C(Z,(\prod_{j}\,(U_{t(j)}\to X)).\mathrm{left})$. Restriction precomposes the represented maps. Faces delete the indicated coordinate using the product projection. Apply the free abelian group functor objectwise and take the alternating chain complex $K$, with differential $\sum_j(-1)^j\delta_j$. Then $K$ is exact at $q+1$ for every $q\in\mathbb N$. No covering or injectivity condition is required.

source.place: Tag 03AT (lemma-homology-complex), with the complex of Tag 03AS

proof.text: Evaluate at Z. Write the degree-p basis as pairs (t,a), where t : Fin(p+1) -> I and a : Z -> (product of Over.mk(pi(t(k)))).left. The product projections have the same composite to X by Over.w. The zeroth projection witnesses a lift of this composite. Select a lift depending only on this composite, then prefix it to the projection maps. Construct the prefixed tuple explicitly with Pi.lift in Over X. The projection equations Pi.lift_π characterize it uniquely.

Deletion is the map induced by the product projections. It preserves the composite to X and hence the selected lift. Product uniqueness and the Fin.succAbove identities prove that deleting coordinate zero after prefixing is the identity, and deleting coordinate i+1 commutes with prefixing after deleting coordinate i. Apply AddCommGrpCat.free to these equalities. Evaluation is additive, so the alternating differential is the signed sum of these free deletion maps. Split that sum into its zeroth term and successor terms; the zeroth term is the identity and the successor terms cancel the second composite. Thus the explicitly constructed prefix maps satisfy h d + d k = id in each positive degree. Empty families have no basis elements, so no lift of an absent element is ever requested.

For a cycle x at degree q+1, the contraction identity gives d(h(x))=x because the other summand is k(0)=0. ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff gives exactness of each evaluated short complex. Evaluation preserves homology: its mapHomologyIso identifies evaluated homology with homology of the evaluated complex, which is zero. The identity of the presheaf homology therefore vanishes at every object, hence vanishes by NatTrans.ext. IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero and exact_iff_isZero_homology give exactness of the presheaf short complex, and HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff' gives the claimed ExactAt(q+1).
